ownership.snapshot_writes: Canonical policy directories are registered before first access. Persisters and cleanup share physical-directory RLocks. Source admission guards atomic replace; unrelated legacy parent JSON files are excluded
ownership.compaction: Track every active compact scope including cleanup-driven calls, cancel matching revoked dependencies, reject late publication by source/revision and wait actual scope exit
ownership.io: Track both private and delegated worker futures through OwnedBlockingWork; cancelled observers retain native hydration/snapshot calls. Runtime context cleanup waits admitted I/O and lease close drains actual native work
